scope: Base one-hand swords, daggers, axes, maces and fist weapons, plus ranged bows, guns, crossbows and thrown weapons. Inspected equip requirement at most 60 or not printed; poor through legendary. Inspected equipment restrictions must allow a Horde Rogue. Item statistics come from each item’s own Forever tooltip or an explicitly labeled Classic reference.
listingAccess: Direct Wowhead listings returned HTTP 403. Cached listing pages visibly paginate at 50 rows. No capped first-page list is claimed complete; every record of the named source files was considered.
enumerationNote: The published caches are finite snapshots, not proof every hidden or unobtainable client item has been discovered. Random suffix families are represented by base item IDs, not every rolled suffix combination.
limitations: Live Forever acquisition and availability are not established by a tooltip. An unconfirmed record may be inaccessible, unreleased or unavailable.
Classic acquisition is labeled separately even when an item has a current Forever tooltip. Classic-only records are reference candidates, not confirmed Forever gear.
Unknown equip requirements stay null and are excluded from usable, near-level and upcoming-level filters.
Phase and source names from Classic cannot establish the Forever release schedule.
Random-suffix families are base item IDs, not every rolled suffix combination.
Armor, two-hand weapons, wands, ammunition, crafting recipes, temporary quest tools, named PTR/debug/NYI items and inspected incompatible class/race restrictions are excluded.
Melee and ranged slots have separate roles. Tooltip DPS sorting does not account for your build, current weapon, special attacks, poison behavior, proc value or encounter.
completedScope: All target base-weapon IDs discovered in the three named snapshots were attempted for melee and ranged. Final integration removed 30 recipe wrappers with nested weapon previews and one explicit internal-use test item. This is a broad audited catalog; it is not a claim every possible live or hidden Forever upgrade is known.
unavailableFlagCaution: Tooltip API responses do not expose every page-level unavailable/PTR flag. Named debug records, temporary tools, explicit incompatible restrictions and a specifically verified unavailable legendary were excluded. Unknown-source records remain visibly unconfirmed.
isHordeAvailabilityNote: isHordeAvailable is null unless a documented Horde source is explicit. No item is promised obtainable solely because it has a tooltip. isHordeUsable describes inspected equipment restrictions, not acquisition.

validation.iconCheck: JPEG headers and SHA-256 match each captured source image

melee.scope: Base one-hand swords, daggers, axes, maces and fist weapons with inspected equip requirement at most 60 or not printed; poor through legendary. Horde Rogue-compatible restrictions only. Actual damage and all statistics come from each item’s own Forever tooltip or an explicitly labeled Classic reference.
melee.listingAccess: Direct Wowhead listings returned HTTP 403. Cached listing pages visibly paginate at 50 rows. No capped first-page list is claimed complete; every record of the named source files was considered.
melee.enumerationNote: The published caches are finite snapshots, not proof every hidden or unobtainable client item has been discovered. Random suffix families are represented by base item IDs, not every rolled suffix combination.
limitations: Live Forever acquisition and availability are not established by a tooltip.
Classic acquisition is labeled separately even when the item has a current Forever tooltip.
Phase and source names from Classic cannot establish the Forever release schedule.
Ranged weapons, armor, temporary quest tools, PTR/debug/NYI records and incompatible class or explicit Alliance-only restrictions are outside this catalog.
melee.completedScope: Every target base weapon record in the three enumerated snapshots was attempted. This is a broad audited catalog, not a claim every possible live or hidden Forever upgrade is known.
melee.unavailableFlagCaution: Tooltip API responses do not expose every page-level unavailable/PTR flag. Named debug records, temporary tools, explicit incompatible restrictions and a specifically verified unavailable legendary were excluded. Unknown-source records remain visibly unconfirmed.
melee.isHordeAvailabilityNote: isHordeAvailable is null unless a documented Horde source is explicit. No item is promised obtainable solely because it has a tooltip. isHordeUsable describes inspected equipment restrictions, not acquisition.

validation.iconCheck: JPEG headers and SHA-256 match each captured source image

questReferenceEnrichment.note: Quest names and factions are reference acquisition metadata, separate from refreshed Forever item statistics.

ranged.scope: Base bows, guns, crossbows and thrown weapons usable in the Rogue ranged/stat slot. Inspected required level at most 60 or not printed; poor through legendary. Wands, melee weapons and incompatible explicit class/faction restrictions are excluded.
ranged.listingAccess: Same complete published discovery snapshots as the melee catalog. Direct Wowhead listings returned HTTP 403 and cached listing pages paginate at 50 rows; this is not a capped first-page scrape.
ranged.enumerationNote: All target records in the named snapshots were considered, then actual discovered IDs were requested from Forever and, if absent, Classic. Hidden/live acquisition remains unknown. Random suffixes are base families, not every rolled variant.
limitations: A current Forever tooltip proves a database record, not a live acquisition route.
Classic reference tooltips and acquisition remain distinctly labeled.
Ranged/stat-slot entries are separate from Combat sword and Subtlety dagger melee choices.
Public snapshots and tooltip flags cannot prove every hidden item is obtainable.

validation.recipeWrapperExclusion: Top-level recipe prefixes and target slot/type block appearing only after a second item-name marker are excluded.
